title: Welcome
needKey: To organize your Gmail, {{app}} needs a Google key. You only do this once.

steps.project: In Google Cloud create a project and enable the Gmail API.
steps.consent: In Google Auth Platform set the app as “External” and add yourself as a test user.
steps.client: In Clients create a “Desktop app” client and download its JSON.
steps.upload: Load it here. It is kept only on this computer.

connectText: Your browser opens: pick your account. If you see “Google hasn't verified this app”, press Continue (the app is you) and accept the permissions.

page.title: {{app}} is connected
page.message: You can close this tab and go back to {{app}}.
